selectedDefinition.C: For each sign bucket C+/C-, retain only zero versus positive.
selectedDefinition.D: For each sign bucket D+/D-, retain 0,1,2,3+.
selectedDefinition.A: For each sign bucket A+/A-, retain 0,1,2+.

findings.statement: Within the common owner-symmetric signed-parity exchange carrier, the C family needs only separate plus/minus presence. Every tested count refinement of C is value-redundant once D and A carry sufficient information.

Every common-exact EW-RS-076 grid point has D=CLIP3. No PRESENCE, ZOE, or CLIP2 realization of the D family is common-exact, so the 2-versus-3+ distinction is localized to depth-change counts within the frozen family partition.
A requires only CLIP2 in the unique Pareto-minimal common law. On 4x5-k4, A=PRESENCE leaves six contradictions and A=ZOE leaves four, while A=CLIP2 is exact.
Under the corrected frozen information partial order, the unique Pareto-minimal common exact family saturation law is C=PRESENCE, D=CLIP3, A=CLIP2.
All 64 family-saturation candidates are scalar-exact on 6x3-k3 and 6x3-k4; 4x5-k4 alone reduces the common exact set to eight and therefore determines the current transfer MSS.
On 4x5-k4 the selected Pareto-minimal carrier has rank 252 versus uniform CLIP3 rank 253 while preserving the full two-dimensional scalar image.

nextQuestion: Can plus/minus channels within C, D, and A be coupled, netted, unordered, or otherwise reduced while preserving the unique Pareto-minimal exchange carrier and scalar image?
nonclaims: The selected family-specific saturation is minimal only within the frozen EW-RS-076 family grid and partial order.
The result does not establish that each plus/minus channel is separately necessary.
No individual bucket coefficient or scalar syndrome is frozen.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
